lives_works: London; later Bembridge, Isle of Wight
notes: British actor, photographer and art director (1874–1939); father of the painters Cavendish and Concord Morton. Died in a London nursing home, 29 June 1939.

items.title: Light and Magic: The Birth of Art Photography

items.text: Cinema Acting: A Handbook for Amateurs (presumed lost; possibly the earliest British guide to film acting)
Stage debut in a New York production of The Prodigal Daughter
Moved to London; actor with the companies of Charles Wyndham and Herbert Beerbohm Tree
Directed the silent film The Broken Melody
Photographer; his wife, the novelist and actress Concordia Merrel, posed for many of his photographs; much of his photographic work was lost when his studio burned in the London Blitz
